state_snapshot.overall_goal: Expand the logistics tracking application to include domestic parcel tracking and sea shipping, using a hybrid WASM/frontend architecture, MapLibre GL JS for mapping, and an updated UI.

active_constraints.constraint: Implement domestic parcel tracking using the `deliveryapi.co.kr` API, including auto-detection and manual carrier selection.
Integrate MapLibre GL JS for OpenStreetMap-based route visualization.
Add sea shipping tracking using the `Searoute` library's data (GeoJSON shipping lanes).
Ensure all new data is integrated into the WebAssembly module (`nuke_blob.bin`).
Adhere to GitHub Pages 1GB size limit and browser memory limitations by using a hybrid architecture for EGIS data (WASM for indices, frontend for dynamic tile loading).
Implement a new UI design for tabs: smooth rounded corners, monotone styling, with a small accent color in the top-right of the tab button, maintaining integration with the body.
Prefer C-language implementation for logic where possible, especially for core engine functions.
For domestic parcels, compare the shortest road-based distance (via OpenStreetMap) with the actual delivery path to assess delivery reasonableness.
Implement heuristic logic for ambiguous domestic logistics cases using pre-saved major logistics centers or regional central points.

key_knowledge.fact: The project utilizes C for core logistics engine logic, Python for data ingestion, and JavaScript for the frontend.
The WebAssembly module (`nuke_kernel.wasm`) loads a custom binary blob (`nuke_blob.bin`) for an in-memory graph representation.
Domestic parcel tracking implements carrier ID auto-detection based on tracking number length, regex patterns, and a Modulus 7 checksum algorithm.
The `deliveryapi.co.kr` service is selected for domestic parcel tracking due to its free tier, JSON output, and REST API compliance.
Sea shipping route data is sourced from `Shipping_Lanes_v1.geojson` (derived from the `newzealandpaul/Shipping-Lanes` GitHub repository).

The `nuke_routes.db` SQLite schema has been unified, replacing the `airports` table with `nodes` (including a `layer` column) and updating the `routes` table (adding `layer` and `path_geojson` columns).
The binary blob (`nuke_blob.bin`) format has been updated to Version 3 to include node countries, node layers, and route layers.
The mapping of layer strings to integers ('air': 0, 'sea': 1, 'land': 2) defined in Python scripts must be consistently applied and interpreted in C code.

The `path_geojson` for routes is stored in `nuke_routes.db` but the full GeoJSON `LineString` geometry is currently *not* loaded into the C-side graph structure; route path visualization in MapLibre will be reconstructed from node coordinates.
The core C engine (`src/nuke_flight.c`) now processes blob Version 3 and references generic `node_` and `route_` structures rather than `airport_` specific ones.
The frontend uses MapLibre GL JS for map rendering, replacing the custom canvas-based tile drawing, utilizing `https://tiles.stadiamaps.com/styles/stadium-dark.json` as an example style.
The `nuke_path_result_t` structure in `include/nuke_flight.h` now includes a `layer` field to identify the layer (e.g., "air", "sea") of the path.
Major logistics centers and regional points are defined in `docs/app.js` with keywords and coordinates to aid heuristic location matching.

artifact_trail.item: Added a new tab for "국내 택배 추적" (Domestic Parcel Tracking), placeholders for MapLibre map containers, and MapLibre GL JS CDN links.
Modified `.mode-tabs`, `.mode-tab`, and `.mode-tab.active` to implement the new tab UI design (smooth rounded corners, monotone, top-right accent, no gradients).

Renamed `state.airports` and `state.airportMap` to `state.nodes` and `state.nodeMap`. Added `fetchDomesticTrackingEvents`, `handleDomesticTrackingFetch`, `verifyMod7Js`, and `resolveDomesticCarriers` for domestic tracking functionality. Refactored `setTrackingStatus`, `renderTrackingMetrics`, and `renderTrackingTimeline` to accept an `element` parameter for reusability. Updated international tracking function names (`handleTrackingFetchIntl`, `runTrackingAnalysisIntl`). Initialized MapLibre maps (`mainMapLibre`, `modalMapLibre`) and defined `MapLayerStyle` for nodes, routes, and ORS road routes. Introduced `updateMapNodes`, `updateMapRoutes`, and `updateORSMapRoute` for MapLibre map data updates. Removed old canvas-related map rendering and interaction logic. `fetchNodes` introduced to load node data from WASM. Updated `computeBestDestinationsLocal`, `computeBestDestinationsNative`, `requestBestFrom`, `requestBestTo` to use node data. Updated `searchRoutes` to correctly display node codes and render routes using `updateMapRoutes`. Updated `setInputField` to use MapLibre's `setFeatureState` for highlighting. Removed unused `assetPaths.airportsJson`. Added `ORS_API_KEY` and `ORS_BASE_URL` constants. Added `fetchORSPath` function to retrieve road-based paths from OpenRouteService. Modified `enrichTrackingEvents` to include `lat` and `lon` for events by resolving aliases against `state.nodeMap` and `MAJOR_LOGISTICS_CENTERS`. Modified `handleDomesticTrackingFetch` to call `fetchORSPath`, display the ORS road route on MapLibre, and show the road distance in the UI. Added `MAJOR_LOGISTICS_CENTERS` constant with predefined locations and keywords. Enhanced `normalizeTrackingLocation` to use `MAJOR_LOGISTICS_CENTERS` for heuristic matching.

New script created to parse `Shipping_Lanes_v1.geojson` and append sea nodes/routes into `nuke_routes.db`. Modified to correctly handle `MultiLineString` geometries and ensure unique node code generation.
New script created to define and initialize the unified `nodes` and `routes` table schema in `nuke_routes.db`.
Modified to no longer manage schema; its `seed_data` now appends air nodes/routes to the unified `nuke_routes.db`. Modified `load_airports` to deduplicate nodes by `code` before insertion.

Modified to first call `scripts/create_db_schema.py`, then `scripts/download_openflights.py`, then `scripts/ingest_openflights.py`, followed by downloading `Shipping_Lanes_v1.geojson` and calling `scripts/ingest_maritime.py`.

Updated `nuke_flight_store_t`, `nuke_path_result_t` structs and related definitions (`NUKE_MAX_NODES_IN_PATH`, `nuke_store_has_node`) to use `node_` prefixes and include `node_layers` and `adj_route_layers` fields. Added `layer` field to `nuke_path_result_t`. Added `#define NUKE_LAYER_MAX_LEN 8`.
Modified to pack `node_countries`, `node_layers`, `adj_route_layers` into the binary blob (Version 3).

Modified `nuke_store_load_from_blob` to parse the Version 3 blob format, populating the new layer data. All `airport_` references were updated to `node_`. Removed old non-WASM data loading functions and calls. Corrected `->` to `.` for `group` members in non-Emscripten `nuke_search_routes` block. Corrected `store->` to `group->store->` for accessing `nuke_flight_store_t` members in `append_result_locked`. Temporarily disabled native `pthread` worker pool initialization and cleanup.

Renamed `nuke_wasm_get_airports_json` to `nuke_wasm_get_nodes_json` and updated its output to include node layer information. Updated `nuke_wasm_search_routes_json` to use node data and include the path's layer in the JSON output. Updated `nuke_wasm_get_health_json`, `nuke_wasm_get_direct_destinations_json`, and `nuke_wasm_get_best_nodes_json` to use node data and include layer information where appropriate. Updated `wasm_collect_forbidden_countries` to use node data.
Renamed `airports` to `nodes` throughout the script and updated related data structures and function calls. Modified message handling to pass node data to the worker and cache it.

Updated all `airport_` references to `node_` in various handlers (`health_handler`, `airports_handler`/`nodes_handler`, `routes_handler`, `direct_handler`, `best_handler`). Renamed `lookup_airport_index` to `lookup_node_index`. Modified `logistics_best_node_t` struct to use `anchor_node` and include `layer`. Added layer information to JSON outputs for nodes and paths. Updated `main` function to use `nodes_handler`.
Renamed `lookup_airport_coords` to `lookup_node_coords`. Updated all `airport_` references to `node_` within `lookup_node_coords` and calls to it. Implemented `copy_upper` function.

Modified to only build WASM components. Removed native application build rules and dependencies on missing `cwist` library. Added `db-setup` phony target to run `bash generate_all.sh`. Made `docs/airports.json` and `docs/wasm/nuke_blob.bin` depend on `db-setup`.
